caption: Figure 1. Top: batch parallelism, the gradients are AllRe- duced to update the parameters. Bottom: Z3/FSDP, note the parameters are sharded and only AllGathered before their use, highlighted in thick blue bars in the figure. The gradi- ents are ReducedScattered before updating the parameters.
subject: how batch parallelism's full AllReduce of gradients contrasts with Z3/FSDP's sharded AllGather of parameters and ReduceScatter of gradients

groups.why_chosen: Contrasting batch parallelism's full-parameter AllReduce of gradients with Z3/FSDP's sharded design, which AllGathers parameters just-in-time and ReduceScatters gradients, trading extra communication for lower peak memory.
groups.what_to_learn: Stack the alternatives when the template is a wide left-to-right chain; let an added element (thick blue bars) plus renamed labels be the entire delta
